title: Assembling the CREW: A Collaborative Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning Framework for Automated Related Work Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.15721v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automatic Related Work Generation (RWG) significantly reduces the human time and effort required to author the Related Work Section (RWS) of a research paper. However, prior methods leveraging multi-agent Large Language Models (LLMs) typically rely on a predefined workflow, where each agent is responsible for a specific step in the entire process. This rigid, static inter-agent coordination limits the adaptive collaboration required to synthesize complex scientific literature. To address this limitation, we propose CREW (Collaborative Reinforcement Learning for Related Work Generation), a novel framework where LLM agents bypass heuristic pipelines to dynamically coordinate by autonomously selecting actions, such as Retrieve, Disseminate, Compose, and Critique, driven by a policy optimized via Independent Proximal Policy Optimization (IPPO). translated_title: 组建CREW：一个用于自动相关工作生成的协作式多智能体强化学习框架
translated_abstract: 自动相关工作生成（RWG）显著减少了撰写研究论文相关工作章节（RWS）所需的人力与时间成本。然而，先前利用多智能体大语言模型（LLMs）的方法通常依赖于预定义的工作流程，即每个智能体负责整个流程中的特定步骤。这种僵化、静态的智能体间协调方式限制了综合复杂科学文献所需的自适应协作能力。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了CREW（用于相关工作生成的协作式强化学习），这是一个新颖的框架，其中LLM智能体绕过启发式流水线，通过自主选择动作（如检索、传播、撰写和批评）实现动态协调，并由通过独立近端策略优化（IPPO）优化的策略驱动。在标准RWG基准上进行的大量实验表明，我们的方法取得了显著的
tldr: CREW框架通过独立近端策略优化（IPPO）驱动LLM智能体自主选择动作并动态协调，突破了传统多智能体预定义工作流的僵化限制，实现了更灵活自适应的自动相关工作生成。
en_tdlr: CREW is a novel framework where LLM agents autonomously select actions and dynamically coordinate through policies optimized via IPPO, overcoming the rigid limitations of predefined multi-agent workflows to enable more adaptive automated related work generation.
